# Ahammed Yaseen

> Ahammed Yaseen (Yaseen) is a Senior Full Stack .NET Developer in Ajman, UAE with 12+ years in ASP.NET Core, React, Angular, .NET MAUI & SQL Server. Portfolio, resume & CV.

Ahammed Yaseen (also known as Ahammed Yaseen Vadakkayil, Yaseen Ahammed, Yaseen) is a Senior Full Stack .NET Developer based in Ajman, UAE. Open to senior .NET roles & freelance projects.

I'm a Senior Full Stack .NET Developer with 12+ years of experience designing and delivering scalable enterprise applications across government, education and enterprise domains in the UAE and India.

I specialise in .NET (6/8/10), ASP.NET Core, ASP.NET MVC, Web API and SQL Server, with Razor, React and Angular on the front end and .NET MAUI and Xamarin for mobile — plus RESTful APIs, authentication systems, CI/CD pipelines, containerised deployments and secure development aligned with OWASP.

Today I lead development of enterprise platforms at City University Ajman — from gathering requirements with academic departments to architecture, delivery and mentoring junior developers.

## Experience

- Senior Software Engineer, City University Ajman (Ajman, UAE), Sep 2020 – Present: Leading development of complex software solutions, including the University Management System (UMS), Lead Management, Task Management, Tactical Operational Plans and the university mobile app.
- Senior Application Web Developer, Ali Mousa Holding (Sharjah, UAE), Sep 2019 – Sep 2020: Managed IT operations and enterprise applications for 12 subsidiaries and 400+ users across the UAE, in real estate, construction and manufacturing.
- .NET Developer, Canada Hitech (Ajman, UAE), Jan 2018 – Jun 2019: Developed specialised software for the Dubai Government, including Dubai Municipality's inspection and advertisement-permit systems, plus an e-commerce platform.
- .NET Developer, Woduru InfoTech (Kerala, India), Mar 2016 – Jun 2018: Responsible for full-cycle development — analysis, coding and debugging — of the CAMPUSKEY and PULSE projects.
- Software Engineer, AIN Technologies (Kerala, India), Aug 2013 – Sep 2015: Designed and tested ASP.NET web and Windows applications (ACOMS and SYSBIZZ).

## Frequently asked

### Who is Ahammed Yaseen?

Ahammed Yaseen (Yaseen) is a Senior Full Stack .NET Developer based in Ajman, UAE, with 12+ years of experience building enterprise web, mobile and desktop applications. He is a Senior Software Engineer at City University Ajman and the developer behind yazcity.com.

### What does Yaseen do as a full stack developer?

Yaseen designs and builds complete systems end to end: ASP.NET Core and MVC back ends, Web APIs, React, Angular and Razor front ends, .NET MAUI and Xamarin mobile apps, and SQL Server databases, deployed on Azure.

### Is Ahammed Yaseen a .NET developer?

Yes. Ahammed Yaseen is a Senior .NET developer working with C#, ASP.NET Core, ASP.NET MVC, Entity Framework, .NET MAUI and Azure, and has delivered university platforms, Dubai Municipality permit and inspection systems, ERP and e-commerce applications.

### Where is developer Ahammed Yaseen based?

Ahammed Yaseen lives in Ajman, UAE and has worked in the UAE for 8+ years, after earlier development roles in India.

### How can I hire or contact Ahammed Yaseen?

Email yaseenvk1990@gmail.com, connect on LinkedIn (linkedin.com/in/yazcity), or use the contact form at yazcity.com/contact. He is open to senior .NET roles and freelance full stack projects.
